feedback: Written before this candidate has raced, so no outcome is stated for it. The candidate is the iteration 1 and 6 baseline (kp 2.0, ki 0, base_speed 1.4, last_direction, weights -2..2, sensors at x -0.02..0.02 and y 0.04, sensor_size 0.012) with kd moved from 0.2 to 0.25. Iteration 6 reproduced iteration 1 exactly (score 75.97, s-bend progress 0.29), so the baseline is reliable. Across the kd tests, s-bend progress was 0.155 at kd 0.1 (iteration 2 and 3), 0.155 at kd 0.15 (iteration 7), and 0.29 at kd 0.2 (iterations 1 and 6). kd 0.25 is the next untested point on that trend. The change is a single lever against the best raced design, and every other lever tried since iteration 1 (base_speed 1.2 and 1.5, kp 2.5, sensor spacing, sensor_size 0.016) lowered the score. max_error has stayed at 0.061 to 0.065 under every setting, so the off-track failure is not yet addressed, and kd is the only lever that has moved s-bend progress. Read the next race in this order. (1) If s-bend progress rises above 0.29 and oval stays near 0.16, keep kd 0.25 as the new best and treat the trend as real. (2) If steering_oscillation on the s-bend rises above about 0.3 with no gain in progress, kd 0.2 is the optimum, so revert to kd 0.2 for the final evaluation. (3) If progress falls below about 0.22 on the s-bend, the trend has peaked, so return kd to 0.2. In every case, keep kp at 2.0 and base_speed at 1.4, since neither has moved max_error.
requested_changes: If the next race shows s-bend progress above 0.29 with steering_oscillation at or below about 0.3, keep kd 0.25 and check whether kd 0.3 gives a further gain, since kd has been the only lever that raised s-bend progress (0.155 at kd 0.15, 0.29 at kd 0.2).

If s-bend progress falls below 0.29 or steering_oscillation grows past about 0.3 without a progress gain, revert kd to 0.2, the value that held progress in iterations 1 and 6, and keep it for the final evaluation.

Keep kp at 2.0 and base_speed at 1.4 for this race. Iteration 3 (kp 2.5) left max_error at 0.062 to 0.065, and iteration 8 (base_speed 1.5) raised oval progress but cut s-bend progress from 0.29 to 0.167.
